results.title: Twenty-five cos Get Nod to Set Up Units in Gwalior Telecom Zone

The LoIs were handed out at a ceremony in Bhopal, nearly four months after the Department of Telecommunications (DoT) and the state government signed the deal to build the zone. The two also announced Phase-II of the zone.
